text:
vik: FYI customer 'rho' onprem reported missing KMS audit lines after an upgrade. decrypts succeed but SIEM shows gaps. anyone free to triage?
sara: Can you share a minimal repro and which deployment profile?
vik: repro: run private deploy with strict-network=true, call /v1/decrypt via keystore-proxy. curl and proxy log: ```POST /v1/decrypt\n200 OK\n2025-04-02T12:01:10Z INFO decrypt ok request_id=xyz123```. but no audit:event in our collector.
tony: quick checklist: (1) SA has logging writer? (2) netpol egress allowed to our collector? (3) sidecar injected and filtering events?
vik: Checked (2) -> they intentionally blocked external egress. (1) SA looks okay in terraform state, still has roles/logging.logWriter.
sara: If netpol blocks egress and strict-network is on, we should be writing local audit backup. Do we have that enabled for this profile?
vik: They picked 'airgap-lite' profile which by default disables local-file backup. that sounds like the root cause.
ton y: That's dangerous — no forward + no local backup. we need policy guard.
log-bot: audit-agent: local-file-write failed: permission denied on /var/log/keystore/audit.log for attempt request_id=xyz123
sara: Now we also see a permission error. fs-audit-writer lost write permission at container runtime (selinux context?). can you paste mount options?
vik: mount is rw, but init container changed owner to root:root. audit writer runs as svcacct:svcacct. init container change happened in image bump rev 7.
tony: Action items short-term: 1) Add temporary egress exception for collector for this customer OR 2) patch init container to preserve ownership for audit volume and redeploy. Which does customer prefer?
sara: Customer prefers no egress changes. they want on-device retention. so do (2). I'll open PR to fix init container + add an acceptance test asserting audit file write permission and presence after init.
vik: Also adding infra gate: any image or init change that alters volume ownership must require manual security sign-off for private profiles.
ton y: I'll add runbook step for oncall: "If audit gaps reported, check netpol->local-backup->fs-perms in that order" and a one-click remediation: apply fix-image and restart pod.
sec-bot: sec-bot: Recommend rotating keys/tokens for the keystore-proxy after permission fix to invalidate any stale creds. Also suggest a metric: audit_local_present_ratio per deployment. alert if <100% for 1m.
sara: I'll file INC-2025-041 and link PRs. will post back when hotfix is in staging.
vik: thanks — triage complete, assigning hotfix to @sara.
